Bike Maintenance Workshop

A free bike maintenance workshop will be held on Saturday 6 June at the Brookside Community Centre, from 10am to 12pm.

A trained mechanic will show how to fix a puncture, adjust brakes, and oil a chain. Participants should bring their own bike.

Places are limited to 15, so booking is required.

Tea and biscuits will be provided.
